interlocks.effect: Abort sequence immediately to VENT (M205) and latch FAIL (M211)

interlocks.cause: Pressure >= 1.00 kPa (D100 >= K100) or PT-2001 fault active (M292) during VENT
interlocks.effect: Inhibit transition from VENT (M205) to UNCLAMP (M206), holding vent valve open and clamp closed

steps.entry: Initial state or pallet leaves ST20 (falling edge of ZS-2008 / ANI X23 while in DONE M207)
steps.exit: Pallet arrival (LDP X23) with Auto mode (X2), not busy (ANI M200), and no ST20 fault (ANI M299)
steps.name: IDLE

steps.exit: Clamp confirmed closed (ZS-2002A / X20) and open switch clear (ANI ZS-2002B / X21)
steps.name: CLAMP (M201)

steps.entry: Clamp confirmed closed from CLAMP step
steps.exit: PT-2001 reaches fill threshold (D100 >= D122 / 14.50 kPa) OR fill timeout (T21) / fault condition aborts to VENT
steps.name: FILL (M202)

steps.entry: Test window complete (T23) OR cycle aborted due to fault / E-stop (M299)
steps.exit: Vent timer done (T24 / T200), pressure vented below 1.00 kPa (D100 < K100), and PT-2001 healthy (ANI M292)
steps.name: VENT (M205)

steps.entry: Vent conditions satisfied (pressure < 1.00 kPa, vent timer done, PT healthy)
steps.exit: Clamp confirmed open (ZS-2002B / X21 made and ZS-2002A / X20 clear)
steps.name: UNCLAMP (M206)

steps.entry: Clamp confirmed open from UNCLAMP step
steps.exit: Pallet leaves test position (falling edge/clear of ZS-2008 / X23)
steps.name: DONE (M207)
